text:
Type: flatwoven runner rug
Use: covering floors in walkways and work spots; hallway, kitchen, entryway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: tight flat weave, space-dyed melange yarn, slim dark bound edges
Colors: grey-beige melange, light cream streaks, charcoal edges
Shape: long narrow rectangle, fine horizontal streaked texture, thin flat profile, slim dark border, light visual weight
Feel: calm, understated, practical
Goes with: grey or beige floors, light wood, white walls, black accents; Scandinavian or modern hallways and kitchens

product.name: HODDE
product.description: Durable, stain resistant and easy to care for since the rug is made of synthetic fibres.
